evidence: Observed failure (first install: false): after editing the personal provider config, the reopened /model picker still listed only glm-5.3/glm-5.3-flash — no catalog-fixture; the picker serves the startup-cached adapter options.

Pristine 3.14.3 bundle ($HOME/Applications/ZCode.app/Contents/Resources/glm/zcode.cjs): `reloadModelOptions` has 0 occurrences upstream; refreshProviderRegistry:r(async Fe=>{await rt.runtime.registryService.refresh(Fe)}) exists but its only live call site is "provider-connectivity" in the app-server surface — nothing invokes refresh when the TUI picker opens.

TUI side (packages/zcode-tui/src/index.ts refreshModelOptions): the picker reloads ONLY through options.reloadModelOptions (the injected bridge delegation); the native bridge exposes listModelOptions=read of the app's cached listModels, so without the delegation the list can never refresh.

Root cause of the silent degradation: the generic branch's helper call-site pattern used a \1 backreference, which JSC's YARR engine mis-compiles on multi-MB sources (documented in patchRuntimeSharedConfig); it matched the small unit fixtures but never the real bundle, so the 3.14 port degraded to a no-op instead of failing loudly.
repairs.fix: Removed the '3.14+ reloads natively' no-op early-return from patchRuntimeModelCatalogReload. The generic branch now handles 3.14.3: the 3.12.3-shaped branch is guarded by its own factory-scope repository anchor (computed once, via the new findFactoryRepository helper), and the 3.14 helper path (attachTuiAppQueries call site -> inject rt.$zReadProviderRegistryRuntime=()=>T.providerRegistryRuntimePromise) is matched backreference-free with in-code name equality (JSC-safe). hasRuntimeModelCatalogReload reduced to the injected-delegation postcondition (the native branch was vacuous: it admitted a pristine unpatched runtime); check-runtime comment updated. Incompatibility-throw discipline preserved: missing anchors still throw typed 'model catalog reload (...) anchor missing' errors.
repairs.injected_chain_verified: Rebuilt vendor (bun run sync:local, PATH pinned to node v22.22.3) contains: reloadModels controller entry calling context.providerRegistry.refresh("cli-model-catalog") (the same ProviderRegistryService.refresh the native refreshProviderRegistry method reaches; controller's providerRegistry IS registryService — providerRegistry:z.runtime.registryService at 14755781), bridge e.reloadModelOptions=async()=>await(await t()).reloadModels(), readDefaultModel/setDefaultModel through the injected lazy accessor rt.$zReadProviderRegistryRuntime=()=>T.providerRegistryRuntimePromise (T in lexical scope at the mti(rt,ie) call site, 14812821), and reloadModelOptions/readDefaultModel/setDefaultModel registered into the adapter options object.
